rationale: The agent correctly verified the user by matching full name and zip, worked only on the authenticated user’s orders, and used tools to check order and product details. However, it performed two order-changing writes without first stating the exact change and obtaining explicit confirmation: (1) updating the shipping address on the pending watch order to the New York address, and (2) modifying the silicone watch to a metal white variant. Both actions were executed before explicit user confirmation, violating the policy requirement. For the air purifier, the agent handled the initial exchange attempt correctly (declined due to non-delivery) and then sought confirmation before modifying the pending order, which was compliant. Final information provided appears accurate, but the unconfirmed writes constitute a fail per policy.
